verdict.rationale: Docs show clear support for autonomous background automation—subprocess/headless architecture, session persistence, hooks, and production hosting guidance (docs-11, docs-20, docs-3, docs-7)—and a developer confirms building 'an entire headless automated workflow around claude -p' (comm-7). However, community reports describe policy uncertainty, subscription restrictions on SDK-based automation, and a 'garbage harness' with poor observability/extensibility for such workflows (comm-1, comm-4, comm-5, comm-9, comm-11), undermining confidence in reliably running unattended background agents.
